description: Bengaluru (Karnataka) [India], February 18 (ANI/NewsVoir): The Wadhwani Institute for Artificial Intelligence was inaugurated in 2018 by the Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi. At Wadhwani AI, it has been our mission to identify problems affecting under-served communities, create AI-powered solutions for those problems, and deploy them at scale, in order to create a significant and sustainable social impact in India. Since our inception, agriculture has been a key focus area for us.
